sync.text: Ƙirƙiri sabon fayil ɗin ajiya a OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive ko Google Drive, ka zaɓe shi a nan, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin ajiya a sauran kwamfutocinka. Tattaunawa, fayiloli da tunawa za su bi ka; saituna da makullai za su zauna a kowace kwamfuta.
sync.waiting: Ka ba da izinin shiga {folder} don ci gaba da daidaitawa da sauran kwamfutocinka.
sync.failed: Ba a iya kaiwa ga {folder} ba. Har yanzu yana wannan kwamfuta?
sync.refused: {folder} na da wasu fayiloli. Zaɓi sabon fayil ɗin ajiya marar komai, ko wanda kake daidaitawa a wata kwamfuta.
